text:
sam (eng-platform): Heads-up — Compliance wants a CSV/stream export of all console changes (who changed what/when) for monthly audits. They need per-resource history and ability to push to our SIEM.

anika (prod): Are they asking for full event payloads or just a diff/summary per change?

maria (eng): Ideally we provide both: an event stream for SIEM + a UI timeline that shows diffs. Export should be filterable (resource, user, timeframe).

jen (compliance): Need immutable exports with chain-of-custody (timestamps, user id, request id). CSV ok but prefer signed objects to S3 we can ingest. Also retention metadata.

lee (security): +1 on signed S3. Also we should redact tokens/PII at ingestion and store HMACs for verification. KMS/HSM signing required for enterprise.

sam (eng-platform): Implementation options: 1) append-only audit topic (kafka) + connector to push to S3/Splunk; 2) on-change write to config-store + change-event webhook; 3) internal queryable store that we export snapshots from. Thoughts?

maria (eng): Option 1 easiest to stream. Option 3 required for on-console "history" view with diffs and search. Could have CDC -> event-store + materialized view for UI.

anika (prod): UX: add a "Change history" tab on each resource with three things: timeline, unified search, "Export" button (CSV/JSON/Streaming). Export should honor org-wide RBAC and tenant filters.

sam (eng-platform): PII redaction — we should run a sanitize step in the pipeline. For diffs we can show masked values and provide full values only in signed enterprise export.

lee (security): Also need tamper-evidence: each exported file should include a signed manifest with a hash chain (or use object-lock on S3).

jen (compliance): Audit logs must include: user.display_name, user.email, user.id, action, resource_type, resource_id, before, after, request_id, region, timestamp, who_approved (if applicable).

sam (eng-platform): Example event we could stream (JSON line) — feel free to comment on fields:
```
{"ts":"2025-11-12T14:22:01Z","user":{"id":"U123","email":"maria@redwood.ai","display":"maria"},"action":"update_routing_policy","resource":{"type":"route","id":"billing-read"},"before":{"policy":"latency-first"},"after":{"policy":"cost-first"},"request_id":"req-8a7f"}
```

maria (eng): Looks good. For UI diffs we want field-level change highlighting. For big JSON blobs we should store a compact diff (jsonpatch).

anika (prod): Question: do we expose internal audit API to customers? Some enterprise customers want their own change logs for their private deployments. Could be opt-in.

lee (security): If we do, ensure cross-tenant isolation and filter-by-tenant at ingest. AuthZ enforced at both API and export.

sam (eng-platform): API blueprint (internal) idea:
```
GET /internal/audit/v1/events?tenant={tid}&resource=route:billing-read&since=2025-11-01T00:00
Response: newline-delimited JSON events (signed headers)
```

sam (eng-platform): Longer-term: add retention tiers: hot (90d queryable), warm (1yr cheap storage), exportable cold (5yr archive). Compliance can request immutable archive.

jen (compliance): Archive retention policies + ability to pull an audit bundle for a timeframe = must-have. Also timestamps must be UTC and monotonic.

maria (eng): Engineering constraints: need to hook all mutating APIs (console, internal, api) into the same audit pipeline. Also capture rollbacks & automated changes (deploy bots).

sam (eng-platform): On that — we need to include actor_type (human | service | automation) in events. Example: "actor_type":"automation", "actor":"deploy-bot".

audit-bot: export-job started for tenant T-42, job id job-20251112-1 :white_check_mark:

anika (prod): For console UI export button — show progress, link to signed S3 when ready, and retention notice. Keep export formats simple: CSV for spreadsheets, NDJSON for SIEM.

lee (security): Add an ACL for "who can request exports" and an approval flow for org-level exports. Record approvals into the same audit log.

sam (eng-platform): Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with architecture options + perf/scale estimates. Volunteers for POC? Need someone to prototype kafka->s3 pipeline and someone to wire UI timeline.

maria (eng): I can do the pipeline POC.

anika (prod): I'll prototype the timeline UX and export button flows.

jen (compliance): I'll write the compliance checklist for the RFC (fields required, retention/immutability constraints).

lee (security): I'll write the security requirements (encryption, signing, ACLs, KMS, redaction).

sam (eng-platform): Great — assigned. I'll open RFC ticket and tag @maria @anika @lee @jen. We should aim for a demo in 3 weeks. :calendar: 

maria (eng): SGTM. Starting POC today.

anika (prod): Will mock a few console screens and flows.

sam (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. If anyone has examples of SIEM ingestion formats (Splunk/Datadog), drop them here.

lee (security): Sharing our Splunk HTTP Event Collector snippet later.

(End of thread)
